question.text: Unlisted equity securities are initially valued at:

answer.text: Cost; subsequently at Fair Market Value (FMV) by an independent valuer

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, unlisted equity is initially valued at cost, then at FMV determined by an independent valuer. The Trap: Zero/face value/book-only ignore fair valuation principles. Cross-Exam Context: Same treatment across AIF categories. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Verify valuer independence — related-party valuers raise red flags.
